issue.title: RefsPanelModelTests queued-digit copy test fails and crashes xctest (Index out of range) on macOS CI since 24e4bc5
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). Since the bob-cli-7k land commit 24e4bc5 ("fix(refs): repair copy card landing behavior"), macOS CI fails `RefsPanelModelTests.testQueuedDigitCopiesWhenTheShowLoaderReturns`. Right after that test, the test process crashes with `Swift/ContiguousArrayBuffer.swift:692: Fatal error: Index out of range`, and xctest exits with `unexpected signal code 5`.

Failing assertions (identical in runs 38609278084 at 24e4bc5, 38610865626 at 734a5b0, and 38617607253 at f2a5cb5):
- `RefsPanelModelTests.swift:122` XCTAssertTrue failed
- `:127` ("nil") is not equal to ("Optional(RefsCore.RefsCopyNotesState.loading)")
- `:129` ("nil") is not equal to ("Optional(RefsCore.RefsCopyKey.note(1))")
- `:130` ("nil") is not equal to ("Optional("Waiting for notes… esc cancels")")
- `:1610` model condition not met before timeout

Then the Index out of range fatal error. The last run without it is 38601917702 at 2b7b330.

Impact: the crash kills the test process, so XCTest cases scheduled after it never run on macOS CI. Bundle, launch smoke, and install are skipped too (bob-cli-7h already skips them). The bob-cli-7n Blocks picker tests in BobMacCaptureTests (CaptureDependencyPanelTests) therefore have no complete macOS CI pass.

Root cause is not established. Likely suspects: an unguarded array index in the copy-card queued-digit path, or in the test's fixture loader, reached after the show-loader wait times out. Start by diffing 2b7b330..24e4bc5 in Sources/BobMacCapture/Refs* and Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsPanelModelTests.swift.

Found by the bob-cli-7n land agent while checking Mac CI for the 7n.7 phase. Not caused by bob-cli-7n: the failure first appears at 24e4bc5, before f2a5cb5, and f2a5cb5 touches no Refs code.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the same assertions at RefsPanelModelTests.swift:122/127/129/130/1610 and the same Index out of range crash appear on three consecutive CI runs at three different SHAs (38609278084 at 24e4bc5, 38610865626 at 734a5b0, 38617607253 at f2a5cb5), and the test has not passed on any run since 24e4bc5.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-7n landing found that macOS CI crashes mid-suite in a Refs copy-card test introduced by bob-cli-7k (closed), so later Mac test cases never run in CI.
